title: Health & pharmacy
body:
Emergency numbers: police 110, ambulance/fire 119 — both free, nationwide, with English-speaking operators available.

Yamagata city has ordinary drugstore chains (Tsuruha Drug is common across Tohoku) for over-the-counter needs; English support is basic, not fluent medical consultation. Ginzan Onsen and Yamadera have no pharmacy — bring what the group needs for those days.

⚠ Routine vaccinations, MMR included, should be current before departure — check your own doctor or national health authority for Japan's current recommendations.
